title: デビュー戦の後に・First Step

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her debut race over, Fine Motion is so overcome with emotion that she's left speechless. She also expresses a powerful desire to run in more races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But what she needs right now is to train hard to ensure she can endure more intense races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to have her build up more experience while I think about which race we should set as her next objective. First of all, we need to get real results and build her fanbase!
